# Acendio — AI & Digital Growth Agency

> Tagline: Websites, AI receptionists, and growth systems built to convert.
> Objective: Generating qualified inbound appointments and custom-scoped growth systems.

## Services
- Website Development & Maintenance (`/services/website-development-maintenance`): Fast, mobile-first websites with technical SEO, hosting, security updates, backups, uptime monitoring, and ongoing care.
- AI Receptionist (`/services/ai-receptionist`): 24/7 voice and SMS receptionist that answers inbound calls, qualifies leads, books calendar appointments, recovers missed calls via text-back, and logs calls into GoHighLevel.
- Ads Management & Creatives (`/services/ads-management-creatives`): Meta and Google Ads strategy, static and video ad creative production, tracking, retargeting, and A/B testing.
- Review Management & Automation (`/services/review-management-automation`): Automated post-service SMS and email review requests, sentiment routing, AI-assisted replies, and Google Business Profile management.
- CRM & Lead Follow-Up Automation (`/services/crm-lead-follow-up-automation`): GoHighLevel pipeline setup, instant speed-to-lead, multi-channel nurture, old-lead reactivation, and appointment reminders.
- AI Chat & Support (`/services/ai-chat-support`): Website and social chat agents trained on verified company FAQs for lead capture and clean human handoff.
- Custom Software & AI Automation (`/services/custom-software-ai-automation`): Bespoke internal dashboards, API bridges, and structured LLM workflows.
- Social Media Management (`/services/social-media-management`): Strategy, monthly content calendars, post & carousel design, short-form Reels, copywriting, scheduling, community management, and monthly analytics.
- UGC Ads / Video / Post Creation (`/services/ugc-ads-video-post-creation`): UGC-style video ads, product showcases, Reels/TikTok/Shorts, static and carousel ad variations, hooks, scripts, and editing.

## Industries
- Real Estate (`/industries/real-estate`)
- Home Services (`/industries/home-services`)

- Hospitality (`/industries/hospitality`)

## Commercial Approach
Every engagement is scoped to your goals; we provide a custom proposal after a short discovery call (`/contact`).
